standard_prerequisites: the lifting lemma for principal ideals with nonzerodivisor (lemma-get-morphism-nonzerodivisor of the same chapter)
completeness of quotients: C/C[a^infty] is I-adically complete when the intersection of C[a^infty] + a^nC equals C[a^infty] (Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-quotient-complete)
the fibre product description of C from the exact sequence with the torsion submodule
existence of the integer d with C[a^infty] intersect a^dC = 0: for Noetherian C the torsion stabilizes at C[a^e] and Artin-Rees gives the intersection bound (Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-Artin-Rees)
core_obligations: Prove that for I = (a) principal, B with Ext^1 annihilated by a^c, C I-adically complete with an integer d >= 0 such that C[a^infty] intersect a^dC = 0, and n > max(2c, c + d), every map psi_n : B -> C/a^nC lifts to varphi : B -> C agreeing modulo a^{n-c}
proof_roadmap: Pass to C' = C/C[a^infty], which is I-adically complete because the sum C[a^infty] + a^nC is direct for n >= d.
For m >= d the exact rows identify C as the fibre product of C' and C/a^mC over C'/a^mC'.

The nonzerodivisor lifting lemma produces varphi' : B -> C' agreeing with psi_n modulo a^{n-c}C'; pairing it with psi_n mod a^{n-c}C gives a map into the fibre product, which is a map varphi : B -> C since n - c >= d.
difficulty_reason: H3: a fibre-product lifting argument that quotients out the a-power torsion and reassembles the map.
